caveats: Fourteen mortality cells are unavailable and remain null; missing rates do not mean no deaths. Maternal mortality is per 100,000 live births, child mortality per 1,000 live births, and birth/death rates per 1,000 population. These denominators cannot be interchanged. The source warns that estimated mid-year population can differ from census counts. From 2009, civil-registration maternal mortality information is reviewed and supplemented using Family Health Bureau data. This table provides national figures only.
The source uses .. for unavailable figures and a dash for nil or negligible. Both retain their printed token and a distinct status; neither is converted to an exact zero.
grain: One national vital-statistics measure per observation year
notes: Eight annual observations for each of six national measures: estimated mid-year population, crude birth and death rates, maternal mortality, under-five mortality and infant mortality. The Registrar General figures are reproduced in DCS table 2.7. Population is in thousands; rate denominators are retained separately. The source marks 2018–2021 revised and 2022–2025 provisional.
